## Disagreements

|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 63 | "storehouses" | "barns" | "storerooms" | Storage facility term |
| 2 | 63 | "put my money to use" | "invest my money" | "put my money to work" | Deployment of capital verb |
| 3 | 63 | "thinking in his heart" | "his thoughts" | "turning over in his mind" | Interior thought idiom |
